title: In Silico Analysis of the Binding Mode of Verteporfin, a YAP-TEAD Interaction Inhibitor.
authors: Ikegami, Yurika; Kudo, Genki; Hirao, Takumi; Yoshino, Ryunosuke; Hirokawa, Takatsugu
one_liner_zh: 该文用AlphaFold2建模和分子对接分析维替泊芬异构体与YAP-TEAD复合物的结合模式，属蛋白-蛋白互作界面抑制剂的计算机模拟，虽非TF-DNA体系，但复合物建模与对接方法可迁移至TF-DNA互作研究。
abstract: The Hippo signaling pathway plays a central role in regulating cell growth, and dysregulation of its downstream effector Yes-associated protein (YAP) leads to tumorigenesis. Verteporfin (VP), a clinically approved drug, inhibits YAP-TEA domain (TEAD) complex formation, yet its binding mechanism remains unclear. In this study, we conducted a comprehensive in silico analysis of all 4 VP isomers within the context of the full-length YAP-TEAD complex. The complex structure was modeled using AlphaFold2 multimer, which provided sufficient accuracy for docking simulations despite incomplete experimental data on YAP. Docking calculations were performed against 2 grids, one centered on a predicted druggable pocket and the other on the YAP-TEAD interface. A total of 304 poses were generated, and the top-scoring 100 were clustered using protein-ligand interaction fingerprints. Clusters derived from the interface grid revealed strong interactions with residues critical for YAP-TEAD binding. Among the 4 isomers, Ia-2 consistently showed the most favorable binding free energies. Notably, Cluster 7 highlighted a unique Ia-2 binding mode involving simultaneous interactions with Met86 and Arg87, suggesting a competitive mechanism at the YAP-TEAD interface. These results suggest that structural chirality may influence binding stability and interaction patterns, and that the Ia-2 isomer is predicted to preferentially stabilize an inhibitory binding mode. This study provides the first systematic comparison of all VP isomers with full-length YAP and suggests that isolating Ia-2 from Visudyne may enhance anticancer efficacy. The findings further support the rational strategies for designing selective YAP-TEAD inhibitors.
abstract_zh: Hippo信号通路在调控细胞生长中发挥核心作用，其下游效应因子Yes相关蛋白（YAP）的失调导致肿瘤发生。维替泊芬（Verteporfin, VP）是一种临床获批药物，可抑制YAP-TEA结构域（TEAD）复合物的形成，但其结合机制尚不明确。在本研究中，我们在全长YAP-TEAD复合物背景下，对所有4种VP异构体进行了全面的计算机模拟分析。复合物结构使用AlphaFold2 multimer建模，尽管YAP的实验数据不完整，该模型仍为对接模拟提供了足够的准确性。对接计算针对2个网格进行，一个以预测的可成药口袋为中心，另一个以YAP-TEAD界面为中心。共生成304个构象，得分最高的100个使用蛋白质-配体相互作用指纹进行聚类。源自界面网格的聚类显示，与对YAP-TEAD结合至关重要的残基存在强相互作用。在4种异构体中，Ia-2始终表现出最有利的结合自由能。值得注意的是，聚类7突出显示了Ia-2的一种独特结合模式，涉及与Met86和Arg87的同时相互作用，提示其在YAP-TEAD界面存在竞争性机制。这些结果表明，结构手性可能影响结合稳定性和相互作用模式，且预测Ia-2异构体优先稳定抑制性结合模式。本研究首次对全长YAP背景下所有VP异构体进行了系统比较，并提示从Visudyne中分离Ia-2可能增强抗癌疗效。这些发现进一步支持了设计选择性YAP-TEAD抑制剂的合理策略。
